title: The version checks record nothing of the image members boot
foundBy: session agent, reviewing how local builds reach campaign members (tasks/pin-on-local-builds.md, section 8)
details: `UpstreamCheck` and `upstream-fingerprint.json` record the cs-sandbox version, and nothing of the image its members boot. Once a local build of a version can be tagged under a localhost/ name, the version alone no longer says which bytes a campaign ran on. The doctor also says `cs-sandbox on PATH` when `CS_SANDBOX_BIN` names another binary.
